description: Synthetic MedOrbits roles and permissions for local development and automated authorization tests. Production authorization must be enforced by the server.

roles.name: user
roles.description: Standard registered applicant or platform user.

roles.name: counsellor
roles.description: Counsellor with access to assigned applicant records and admissions workflows.

roles.name: employer
roles.description: Employer permitted to manage their own recruitment listings and access job applicants only where authorized.

roles.name: admin
roles.description: Administrative role for authorized platform operations. High-impact actions must use restricted, audited workflows.

Read applications assigned to the authenticated counsellor.
Update permitted fields on assigned applications.
Read only applicant information necessary for the employer's own job listings, subject to consent, privacy controls, and server-side authorization.
Read applications for authorized administrative purposes.
Update applications for authorized administrative purposes.
Register a document upload for the authenticated user after upload validation.
Read document metadata owned by the authenticated user.
Request deletion of the authenticated user's own document where permitted.
Read document metadata for applicants assigned to the authenticated counsellor.
Review documents belonging to applicants assigned to the authenticated counsellor.
Read documents under administrative policy, ownership restrictions, and audit controls.
Review documents under administrative policy and audit controls.
Read published or otherwise authorized college records.
Create college records through authorized administrative workflows.
Update college records through authorized administrative workflows.

Read published or otherwise authorized course records.

Read the authenticated user's own subscription metadata.
Read subscription records for authorized administrative purposes.

metadata.securityNote: Test definitions only. Enforce permissions server-side, validate record ownership and counsellor assignments, apply least privilege, prevent unauthorized role escalation, and audit sensitive actions.
